title: 贝恩资本John：资本成本上升反成好事，私募行业加速整合
speaker: John Connaughton

segments.en: Some of your peers have had very good in terms of capital raising.
segments.zh: 你们的一些同行在募资方面表现很好。

segments.en: And I think, do you see a similar appetite right now?
segments.zh: 我想，你觉得现在有类似的兴趣吗？

segments.en: And do you think there's enough deals to be able to buy capital?
segments.zh: 你认为有足够的交易来配置资金吗？

segments.en: Yeah, it's funny. I think there's a tale of two cities.
segments.zh: 是的，很有趣。我觉得这是两个城市的故事。

segments.en: I think our Asia Fund was like 33% larger than our last Asia Fund.
segments.zh: 我们的亚洲基金比上一期大了约33%。

segments.en: Our North America Fund was about 20% larger.
segments.zh: 我们的北美基金大了约20%。

segments.en: We're raising Europe now, even Europe. I think we expect that'll be larger than our last fund.
segments.zh: 我们现在在募集欧洲基金，甚至欧洲。我们预计会比上一期大。

segments.en: And across all of our 12 strategies, in real estate, credit, special sits, we've been able to raise more money.
segments.zh: 在我们所有的12个策略中，包括地产、信贷、特殊机会，我们都能够募集更多资金。

segments.en: So I do think it's a consolidation going on right now. Partly because we've been providing liquidity, our investors want to re-support us with that as a reinvestment.
segments.zh: 所以我认为现在正在发生整合。部分原因是我们一直在提供流动性，我们的市场参与者希望以再**的方式继续支持我们。

segments.en: But I don't think that's the case for most of our industry.
segments.zh: 但我认为我们行业的大部分情况并非如此。

segments.en: But in terms of deployment, no, I don't feel like we're having any challenges with deployment right now.
segments.zh: 但就部署而言，不，我不觉得我们现在在部署上有什么挑战。

segments.en: Right. And maybe just slightly under fund raising side that could be from your perspective or from the perspective of Kirkland.
segments.zh: 对。或许在募资方面稍显不足，这可能是从你的角度或柯克兰的角度来看。

segments.en: I mean, capital is slightly more expensive this year. It is.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，今年资本稍微贵了一些。确实如此。

segments.en: I don't know that capital being expensive is a deterrent for our business.
segments.zh: 我不知道资本昂贵是否会阻碍我们的业务。

segments.en: I mean, honestly, I think if anything, the lessons of 19, 20, and 21, which will probably be one of the worst ventages for private equity,
segments.zh: 老实说，我认为19、20和21年的教训——那可能是私募股权最糟糕的年份之一——

segments.en: I think was a false positive in terms of the capital cost being so low that it created a lot of mistakes.
segments.zh: 我认为资本成本过低是一个假阳性，它造成了许多错误。

segments.en: It was a momentum period. People leaned into very high values.
segments.zh: 那是一个动量期。人们倾向于非常高的估值。

segments.en: And I think that's one of the problems you're seeing with liquidity with a lot of those folks that did.
segments.zh: 我认为这就是许多这样做的人在流动性方面遇到的问题之一。

segments.en: And so that's an unhealthy environment. When we have a higher cost of capital, then it sort of takes away some of the momentum that goes into deployment and it goes back to the fundamentals.
segments.zh: 所以那是一个不健康的环境。当我们有更高的资本成本时，它会消除一些部署的动量，回归基本面。

segments.en: Are you building businesses or are you growing them? Are you building a transformation strategy with AI?
segments.zh: 你是在建立企业还是在发展它们？你是在用AI制定转型战略吗？

segments.en: All of these things, I think, are more fundamental than just cost of capital.
segments.zh: 我认为所有这些因素都比单纯的资金成本更根本。

segments.en: There's fears in this market of a bubble.
segments.zh: 市场中有泡沫的担忧。
